gdp.name: GDP
gdp.about: Gross domestic product: the total value of everything a country produces in a year, in current US dollars.

perCapitaIncome.name: GDP per capita
perCapitaIncome.about: GDP divided by population, in current US dollars: a common measure of average economic output per person.

inflation.name: Inflation
inflation.about: How fast consumer prices rise each year, measured by the consumer price index.

unemploymentLaborForce.name: Unemployment
unemploymentLaborForce.about: The share of the labour force without a job that is available for and looking for work.

debt.name: Government debt
debt.about: Central government debt as a share of GDP. Many countries report it only for some years.

foreignReserve.name: Foreign reserves
foreignReserve.about: Total reserves including gold held by a country's central bank, in current US dollars.

fdiInflows.name: FDI inflows
fdiInflows.about: Net foreign direct investment entering a country in a year, in current US dollars.

fdi.name: FDI to GDP
fdi.about: Net foreign direct investment inflows as a share of GDP, which shows their size against the economy.

population.name: Population
population.about: The total number of people living in a country, by mid-year estimates.

lifeExpectancy.name: Life expectancy
lifeExpectancy.about: The number of years a newborn would be expected to live at current death rates.

internetUsers.name: Internet users
internetUsers.about: The share of a country's population using the internet.

povertyLevel.name: Extreme poverty
povertyLevel.about: The share of people living on less than $3.00 a day (2021 PPP), from household surveys.

incomeInequality.name: Income inequality
incomeInequality.about: The Gini index: 0 means everyone has the same income, 100 means one person has it all.

gdpGrowth.name: GDP growth
gdpGrowth.about: The yearly change in a country's GDP after removing inflation.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing
manufacturing.about: The value added by manufacturing as a share of GDP.

exports.name: Exports
exports.about: Goods and services sold abroad, as a share of GDP.

imports.name: Imports
imports.about: Goods and services bought from abroad, as a share of GDP.

remittances.name: Remittances
remittances.about: Money sent home by people working abroad, as a share of GDP.

militarySpending.name: Military spending
militarySpending.about: Government spending on the military as a share of GDP.

populationGrowth.name: Population growth
populationGrowth.about: The yearly change in a country's population, in percent.

urbanPopulation.name: Urban population
urbanPopulation.about: The share of people living in urban areas.

fertilityRate.name: Fertility rate
fertilityRate.about: The average number of children a woman would have at current birth rates.

femaleLaborForce.name: Women in the workforce
femaleLaborForce.about: The share of women aged 15 and over who are working or looking for work.

infantMortality.name: Infant mortality
infantMortality.about: Deaths of babies under one year old, per 1,000 live births.

healthSpending.name: Health spending
healthSpending.about: Total current spending on health care as a share of GDP.

educationSpending.name: Education spending
educationSpending.about: Government spending on education as a share of GDP. Many countries report it only for some years.

co2Emissions.name: CO2 emissions
co2Emissions.about: Carbon dioxide emissions per person each year, in tonnes.

renewableEnergy.name: Renewable energy
renewableEnergy.about: The share of final energy use that comes from renewable sources.

electricityAccess.name: Electricity access
electricityAccess.about: The share of people with access to electricity.

forestArea.name: Forest area
forestArea.about: The share of a country's land covered by forest.

Explorer.noDataRange: No data for these countries in these years. Try a wider range.
Explorer.rankingNote: Latest figure for each country in the selected years.
Explorer.sparseNote: Reported irregularly. Dots mark real figures; lines join them.
